text: Carpentry is the ancient craft of constructing structures and furniture from wood. It begins with careful planning and designing, before cutting the initial pieces of timber, often using tools like chisels and mallets. Varnish is a crucial step, applied to protect the wood’s surface, providing a shiny finish and protecting it from moisture and wood decay. Once the varnish dries, the joint connections are made, ensuring the structure remains stable and solid. Over time, carpenters also work on refining these joints with techniques like mortise and tenon or peg and mortise, enhancing both durability and aesthetic appeal.
